key_insight: The paper proposes a static PV array reconfiguration method that uses the actual partial-shading pattern, rather than assumed shading regions, to maximize power output.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical low-complexity alternative to dynamic reconfiguration for real solar PV installations facing fixed, time-varying shading from buildings, trees, or other obstructions.
method: Formulate SAR as an integer linear programming problem.
Rearrange PV modules according to the observed shading pattern across the array.
Validate on both square-array simulations and a non-square laboratory prototype.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent optimal power output in both software simulation and practical experiments compared with existing reconfiguration techniques.
watch_item: Because the approach is static, it cannot adapt to new or rapidly changing shading conditions after the one-time configuration.
paper_title: An Integer Linear Programming Approach for Maximum Power Extraction from Solar PV Plants under Partial Shading
